# Liquid Chrome (`liquidChrome`)

Molten mirror metal, optionally iridescent.

- Type: scene (draws its own image; put it first)
- Reacts to: nothing outside itself (pure motion)
- Cost: medium (~4.6 ms/frame at 5K on a Pro GPU)
- Built-in styles: Liquid Chrome

## Params

| key | label | kind | range / options | default |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `speed` | Speed | slider | 0 … 2 | 0.6 |
| `scale` | Ripple Scale | slider | 0.5 … 3 | 1.2 |
| `iris` | Iridescence | slider | 0 … 1 | 0.12 |
| `ripple` | Fine Ripples | slider | 0 … 1 | 0.35 |
| `rough` | Roughness | slider | 0 … 1 | 0.06 |
| `aniso` | Brushed | slider | 0 … 1 | 0 |
| `film` | Film Tone | slider | 0 … 1 | 0.5 |
